title: Field boundaries for Switzerland
description:
The agricultural usage areas of Switzerland ("Nutzungsflächen", federal model 153.1) are the plots whose use each canton records as the basis for direct payments. Every canton publishes its own data under its own terms; geodienste.ch distributes them as one GeoPackage per canton in the shared model, current state only. Three cantons keep earlier years on their own portals: [Zürich](https://github.com/fiboa/data-survey/blob/main/data/CH-ZH.md) (2017–2025), [Geneva](https://github.com/fiboa/data-survey/blob/main/data/CH-GE.md) (2017–2026) and [Schwyz](https://github.com/fiboa/data-survey/blob/main/data/CH-SZ.md) (2022–2024).

This collection is fed by 20 fiboa-cli converters, one per source: Switzerland, Aargau (`ch_ag`), Switzerland, Appenzell Innerrhoden (`ch_ai`), Switzerland, Appenzell Ausserrhoden (`ch_ar`), Switzerland, Bern (`ch_be`), Switzerland, Basel-Landschaft (`ch_bl`), Switzerland, Fribourg (`ch_fr`), Switzerland, Geneva (`ch_ge`), Switzerland, Glarus (`ch_gl`), Switzerland, Graubünden (`ch_gr`), Switzerland, Jura (`ch_ju`), Switzerland, Luzern (`ch_lu`), Switzerland, St. Gallen (`ch_sg`), Switzerland, Schaffhausen (`ch_sh`), Switzerland, Solothurn (`ch_so`), Switzerland, Schwyz (`ch_sz`), Switzerland, Thurgau (`ch_tg`), Switzerland, Uri (`ch_ur`), Switzerland, Valais (`ch_vs`), Switzerland, Zug (`ch_zg`), Switzerland, Zürich (`ch_zh`). It holds 40 editions (2017–2026), one GeoParquet file and one STAC item per source and year: `year=<year>/<converter>-<year>.parquet`. The sources publish under different terms, so the collection's license is `other` with a link to each, and every item carries its own source's `license`, `attribution` and `providers`.

Read every edition at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ch/year=*/*.parquet`, or the newest edition of every source with `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ch/latest/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`; the files differ in columns, so read them with `union_by_name = true`). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:2056). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ch/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are declared: they come from farmers' subsidy applications, or from the parcel register built on those declarations.

Kanton Zürich, Amt für Landschaft und Natur

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: crop:name
table:columns.description: Crop name in the original language. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: hcat:code
table:columns.description: The 10-digit HCAT code indicating the hierarchy of the crop. The first 4, 6, 8 digits select increasingly specific crop groups. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: hcat:name_en
table:columns.description: The original crop name translated into English. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: crop:code
table:columns.description: The crop code, from the code list of the source. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: hcat:name
table:columns.description: The machine-readable HCAT name of the crop (Hierarchical Crop and Agriculture Taxonomy, EuroCrops). ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset: the converter variant, or for a source without variants the most frequent year of `determination:datetime` in the file. Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

visual.title: Field boundaries for Switzerland — latest edition of every source (PMTiles)

style-hcat-crops.title: Crops (HCAT)
style-hcat-crops.description: Fields coloured by harmonized crop (EuroCrops HCAT code, `hcat:code`). The 12 crops covering the most area are named, everything else is grey. Colours follow the fiboa.org crop map palette.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.1, 0.25, 1 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
